build.notes: Values at pin 50992953 (v0.9.5-43-g50992953, synced 2026-11-20): 150 model_specs families, 465 downloadable packages (all huggingface_snapshot), 9 unsupported packages, 18 spec task tokens (unchanged). Counts are static from the pinned model_specs tree; linked loader/catalog counts are re-measured from the shipping shim at release time (previous pin measured 137 = 134 + 3 bundled VADs). This pin is a fork merge commit: upstream 0xShug0/audio.cpp main 29b37ddb (54 commits past 4be37c28, 563 changed paths, includes v0.9.5) merged into the fork; the two local download fixes were preserved unchanged in src/framework/package_manager/http_util.cpp: HF_ENDPOINT fallback in huggingface_base_url() and enable_system_ca(true) in configure_client() for the Windows certificate store. repository therefore points at the fork so CI can fetch the exact SHA. Shim ABI stays 1.4 and the shim still reports 0.6.0: of the shim's direct include surface only core/module.h changed (PreparedGraph forward declaration, additive); io/json.h, core/backend.h, package_manager/manager.h and runtime/{registry,session,task_vocabulary}.h are unchanged. Upstream's public C ABI in include/audiocpp.h moved 0.3 -> 0.4 (new audiocpp_result_custom_schema, additive), but the shim exports its own audiocpp_dotnet.h and does not consume that header. Large upstream changes: standalone MoE engine with placement/cache policies, GraphRegionExecutor hooks, YAML CLI config, Windows Xet verification, shared Mimi latent decoder, ggml updates and 7 new families (granite_speech5, m5_tts, rosvot, soulx_singer, tiny_voca, zonos2, zonos3). Rebuild every supported RID/backend and re-run ABI, managed and model E2E tests before release.
